verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents configurable call-routing automations such as auto attendants and ring groups, so asking whether those can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question for this business phone product. The evidence pack never mentions version history, change review or rollback for those configurations. The Admin Reports activities API is a general activity log, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
